name: Ration Theft
description: Emergency rations went missing.|Someone stole Mrs. Berry's premium blueberry ration pie. Track the trail and recover critical food supplies.

text: Seeker! My blueberry ration pie is gone!
That batch was meant for tomorrow's supply allocation!
Find it and I'll cut you in on the recovery.
Following crumb traces, you spot a suspicious squirrel.
Alright, alright! I took the pie! But morale was low!
We've got a canopy party tonight. You in?
completedText: Return the ration pie... or party first?

text: You brought it back! Thank you, Seeker!
Now, about that slice I promised...

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have cracked @crimson@Ration Theft@green@. Enjoy your well-deserved slice of pie!
